circulation: Two declared graph cycles reserve retreat options. Optional tower/bridge branches must never host mandatory evidence without separate fairness review. Actual physical routes and timing remain unaccepted.
systems: Terrain and water boundaries first; then solid architecture with floor depth, fitted doors and circuit isolation. Separate exterior/interior acoustics, supported fixtures and surface-mounted UV evidence. All gameplay integration remains locked.
campaign: Fictional location and records connect to the district investigation; narrative never predetermines the ghost or prevents an evidence-led outcome.
refine: Terrain-first massing is not terrain acceptance: resolve drainage, incised paths, retaining edges, foundation contacts and every grade before detailed structures.
Check floor/wall/roof joins, upper-deck undersides and corners with adjacent lights toggled; log every discovered failure.
Engineer stairs, landings, openings, guards, door swings and two exits before collision/navigation approval.
Inspect each model purpose, scale, UVs and true support surface before placing furniture or clutter.
Public decommissioned-site context only; not a reconstruction of an operational facility.
Keep every mandatory route off the shaft void. Real ring guards, falling protection and stair headroom require engineering.
